playwright_checks.description: Verify E4-S3-AC2: keyboard-only navigation (no mouse) reaches every pagination and delete control on the console list page in a visible, logical focus order, with no keyboard trap. This is distinct from the automated axe scan (VM-023/VM-025 via accessibility_checks) because focus-order and operability are behavioral, not purely a static rule scan.

steps.assertion: the console list page loads and an initial element (e.g. the page's first focusable control) can receive focus
each successive Tab press moves focus to the next interactive element in visual top-to-bottom, left-to-right order, and the currently focused element always shows a visible focus indicator
tabbing reaches the pagination previous-page and next-page controls, and pressing Enter or Space while one is focused changes the displayed page exactly as a mouse click would
continuing to tab reaches each visible row's delete control in order, and pressing Enter or Space while one is focused triggers the same delete action as a mouse click
tabbing backward from the last control retraces the same order in reverse, confirming no element is skipped or traps focus in either direction
